title: 05 sign-off, https://use05.dev/signoff/v0
description: An in-toto Statement v1 carrying a person's sign-off on promoting one exact commit into an environment, or their rejection of it: their own words, their answers to the policy's questions and the statements they confirm, bound to the environment, the source commit and the policy. Subject: the source commit (gitCommit). Signed by their approver key or passkey. Fields are only ever added, as optional ones.

signer_person.description: The person, as the policy names them on their key.

text.description: What they say, in their words.

answers.description: Their answers to the policy's questions, in order.

confirmations.description: The policy's confirm statements they confirm, word for word.
